QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] Hasty Return
QuestInfo.0: A horn blast reverberates across the whole of Skuas, and scouts are sprinting back to the castle with countless monsters on their tail! You've got to buy them enough time to reach the safety of the castle.
